description: Welcome to our clan! I'm a cyber security student and game dev enthusiast looking to expand our squad for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our current skill tree includes ethical hacking, 3D graphics, and video editing. We are actively recruiting new clan members who have leveled up in software development, data analysis, or UI/UX design. If you're a team player ready to grind, solve complex missions, and build something epic, join our guild. Let's conquer this hackathon!
